map.例1（130/85）：脉压 45mmHg → 正常高值（非高血压）。例2（160: Example 1 (130/85): pulse pressure 45 mmHg → high-normal (not hypertension). Example 2 (160/100): pulse pressure 60 mmHg → grade 2 hypertension; medical attention is advised. Example 3 (150/85): pulse pressure 65 mmHg → isolated systolic hypertension.
map.脉压大说明什么？: What does a wide pulse pressure indicate?
map.脉压>60mmHg 常见于动脉硬化、主动脉瓣关闭不全等；老年人脉压增大多与血管弹: A pulse pressure >60 mmHg is commonly seen in arteriosclerosis, aortic regurgitation and other conditions; in older adults a widened pulse pressure is mostly related to reduced vascular elasticity and should be assessed as a whole.
map.家庭自测注意什么？: What should I watch for when self-measuring at home?
map.静坐休息 5 分钟、坐姿背部有支撑、袖带与心脏同高，非同日三次升高才更有意义；单: Rest seated for 5 minutes, sit with your back supported and the cuff at heart level, and only elevations on three different days are more meaningful; a single high reading is no cause for alarm.
map.算法：按中国高血压指南分级——正常 <120/80；正常高值 120–139/8: Algorithm: classify by Chinese hypertension guidelines — normal <120/80; normal-high 120–139/80–89; grade 1 140–159/90–99; grade 2 160–179/100–109; grade 3 ≥180/110; systolic ≥140 with diastolic <90 is isolated systolic hypertension. The higher of the two grades applies.
map.例1（120/80）：脉压 40 mmHg，判正常高值（不是高血压）。例2（15: Example 1 (120/80): pulse pressure 40 mmHg, normal-high (not hypertension). Example 2 (158/96): pulse pressure 62 mmHg, grade 1 hypertension — seek medical advice. Example 3 (150/85): systolic reaches grade 1 with normal diastolic → isolated systolic hypertension.
map.脉压 = 收缩压 − 舒张压（mmHg）；平均动脉压 =（收缩压 + 2×舒张压: Pulse pressure = systolic − diastolic (mmHg); mean arterial pressure = (systolic + 2×diastolic) / 3; the higher band applies: ≥180/≥110 → grade 3 hypertension, 160-179/100-109 → grade 2 hypertension, 140-159/90-99 → grade 1 hypertension, 120-139/80-89 → high-normal, <120/<80 → normal; systolic ≥140 with diastolic <90 → isolated systolic hypertension. Validation: 0<systolic≤300, 0<diastolic≤200 and systolic>diastolic; blank or out-of-range input is refused.
